invite: Editorial conceptual illustration, clean line drawing in black ink on warm off-white paper, flat colors, a single vermilion orange accent color used sparingly, generous empty space, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no computers, no electronics, no circuit boards, no chips, no graphics cards, no cables, no screens. Subject: a mechanic's workshop where an old wooden gear train is being replaced piece by piece by a precise steel gear train, one gear painted vermilion, both trains turning the same shaft
